summary: Left hotel reservation HS48213 on the schedule and asked you whether it still stands, since the mail cancels only one night.

ops.title: Does hotel reservation HS48213 still stand?
ops.text: A mail says one night of your stay was canceled, the last one, and the other two nights are unchanged: "We have canceled one night of your stay, the last one. The other two nights are unchanged." The entry stays as it is until you say whether the reservation still stands.
